aj: Heads up — customer reported fncall failures where enum validation rejected the 'model' field and the router silently fell back to a degen variant. Billing still counted the fallback. Need investigation + dashboard/alert + quick rollout plan.

cheng: can you paste an example log?

aj: sure, here's the request/validation snippet we pulled from logs:
```
ts=2025-05-01T03:21:12Z request_id=req_01Fxyz validation_error=InvalidEnumValue field=model provided='gpt4' expected=[gpt-4,gpt-4o]
router: chosen_variant=degen-v1 fallback_reason=validation_reject cost_tag=charged
```

maria: That matches a spike we saw in eu-west-1: fncall.validation.reject_rate jumped to 4.8% in last hour (14 rejects from 6 customers). One SLO alert already fired.

sam: FYI current behavior: when validation fails we route to degen fallback and still attribute/bill under original route. That's the customer complaint.

cheng: Proposal: 1) add a small coercion map for common enum typos (gpt4 -> gpt-4, gpt4o -> gpt-4o) 2) emit telemetry field 'validation_coercion=auto-mapped' when applied 3) include sample payloads (PID hashed) in rejection telemetry for quick triage.

aj: + we need console UX changes: surface per-route reject_count, top sample payloads, and a toggle to opt into soft coercion per org. Dashboard owner?

maria: I can own the dashboard. Plan: create metric fncall.validation.reject_count (labels: region, route, fallback_variant, validation_reason) and dashboard tile that shows sample payloads (redacted) with a link to replay. Alert: fire when reject_rate > 3% AND rejects > 10 in 5m.

sam: rollout suggestion: feature flag 'enum_soft_coercion' default OFF. Canary flow: internal orgs -> 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100%. Add gating checks: validation_rejects decrease and no increase in billing anomalies. Also add BVT that ensures we don't silently bill degen fallback during canary.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2025-06-02T14:00:00Z (canary-id=fc-enum-coerce-001).

ops-bot: Created ticket INC-9523 to track affected customers and triage steps.

aj: Billing change: we should not bill the degen fallback when original model is rejected. Suggest adding telemetry tag 'fncall.rejected_billing_exempt=true' for events where validation rejected the requested variant. @finance please verify impact.

cheng: technical concern: soft coercion can mask malformed inputs exploited by downstream tooling. We must require audit logs and keep sample retention for 7 days, and surface a 'coercion_applied' flag in logs.

maria: Agreed. retention=7d and include a validation_sample_id for replay. Dashboard will show coercion_rate and top coerced values.

sam: I'll draft the coercion PR + unit tests today and a rollout playbook with rollback criteria (if reject_rate doesn't drop or billing anomalies > 2x). ETA: PR by EOD tomorrow.

aj: Great. Quick action items: 1) Dashboard & alert (maria) 2) Coercion PR + tests + playbook (sam) 3) Billing tag and finance check (cheng + finance) 4) Canary deploy (infra + deploy-bot) 5) Incident ticket tracking (ops-bot).

maria: I'll create the dashboard PR and the alert rule this afternoon.

cheng: I'll coordinate with finance on the billing-exempt tag and scope the attribution change.

sam: Starting work now. Will post draft mapping table for coercion (common typos) in this thread when ready.

aj: Thanks all. Let's meet 10:00 UTC tomorrow to sign off on the canary. :thumbsup:

(ends)
